title: Azerbaijan and Kazakhstan Odyssey with FREE Visit to Charyn Canyon

Visit a beautiful Panfilov Park dedicated to the Panfilov heroes who fought during World War II.
Explore the famous Rahat Chocolate Factory and indulge in delicious chocolates and learn about the chocolate-making process.
Discover the pristine beauty of Kolsay Lakes, a series of stunning alpine lakes situated in the Tien Shan Mountains.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Almaty
days.desc: Qosh keldiniz (You are Welcome) in Kazakhstan! Upon arrival at the Almaty Airport, you will get transferred to your hotel. Check-in and spend the rest of the day at leisure. You can either explore nearby places or visit various attractions including Panfilov Park, Zilyoni Bazaar, Medeu Dam, and many more. Later, head back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Almaty Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Start your day with anticipation as you prepare for a captivating sightseeing tour of Almaty.  During the tour, visit various amazing attractions, including Panfilov Park, dedicated to the Panfilove heroes who participated in World War II. Afterwards, explore the beautiful Republic Square and witness the Monument of Independence, known as the symbol of freedom for Kazakhstan. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Almaty City Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis

days.title: Day Trip to Shymbulak Ski Resort
days.desc: Get ready for a thrilling mountain adventure as you escape to the stunning landscapes surrounding Almaty City with a day trip to Shymbulak Ski Resort. Hop on a cable car for a cool ride up to Shymbulak Ski Resort, enjoying amazing views on the way up. Discover the remarkable scenery and enjoy panoramic views of the surroundings on the way. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink & Shymbulak Ski Resort on a Private basis

days.title: Day Trip to Green Bazaar & Rahat Chocolate Factory | Visit to Kok Tobe Park
days.desc: Begin your day by getting transferred to Green Bazaar. Here, you can buy all kinds of items, from souvenirs to clothes and snacks. Further, enjoy a visit to the Rahat Chocolate Factory to see the process of chocolate as you buy a few of them. After the visit to a chocolate factory, get ready to board your cable car to Kok Tobe Park, where you can enjoy rides and admire the views of the panoramic surroundings. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay

items.title: Trip to Green Bazaar & Rakhat Chocolate Factory, Almaty on a Private basis
Day Trip to Kok Tobe from Almaty on a Private basis

days.title: Day Trip to Issyk Lake
days.desc: Explore the serene beauty of Issyk Lake with a delightful day trip that promises tranquillity and discovery. As you reach the lake, enjoy a leisurely walk around the shores as you take-in the views of the surroundings. Also, visit the State Historical and Cultural Museum-Reserve and learn about the area's past and history. After exploring the place, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Issyk Lake Day Tour From Almaty on a Private basis
Issyk State Historical and Cultural Reserve-Museum

days.title: Day Trip to Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake
days.desc: In the morning, get ready to go for the day trip to Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake. Begin with a visit to the majestic Charyn Canyon, often likened to the Grand Canyon, featuring dramatic rock formations carved over millennia. Then, discover the Kolsai Lake, situated around the Tien Shan mountains. After exploring these  amazing attractions, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Day Trip to Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake From Almaty on a Private basis

days.title: Transfer to Baku
days.desc:
Welcome to Azerbaijan! Upon your arrival at the airport in Baku, you will get transferred to your hotel. After check-in, spend the rest of the day at your own pace. You can either explore nearby places or visit 
Baku Eye, Teze Pir Mosque, Dənizkənarı Milli Park, and other such attractions. Afterwards, head back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Baku Old City Tour | Gobustan National Park & Mud Volcanoes Tour
days.desc: Step back in time as you go on the old city tour of Baku. Explore the amazing streets of Baku's Old City, also known as Icherisheher. Admire the architectural wonders of the Palace of the Shirvanshahs, and ascend the ancient Maiden Tower for breathtaking views of the city skyline. Then, visit the Gobustan 3D Museum to learn about Azerbaijan's prehistoric past before exploring the Mud Volcanoes of Gobustan. Afterwards, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Baku Old City Tour on a Private basis
Gobustan National Park & Mud Volcanoes Tour from Baku on a Private basis

days.title: Transfer to Shahdag | Day Trip to Shahdag Mountain Ski Resort
days.desc: In the morning, check-out from the hotel and get transferred to Shahdag. Upon reaching, check-in at your hotel and rest for a while before going for the Shahdag Ski Tour. Enjoy the scenic slopes and snowy landscapes as you glide down the mountains. With convenient equipment rental, and professional instructors available, all you need to do is show up and prepare for an unforgettable day of adventure in the snow. After a thrilling day, transfer back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Day Trip to Shahdag Mountain Ski Resort on a Private basis

days.title: Leisure Day in Shahdag
days.desc: Enjoy a day of leisure in the stunning Shahdag Winter Complex. Whether you're enjoying the slopes for thrilling skiing adventures or simply admiring the breathtaking mountain scenery, Shahdag offers an unforgettable winter experience. After the fun-filled day, head back to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Baku | Absheron Peninsula Tour
days.desc: Check-out from the hotel in Shahdag & journey back to Baku, with a scenic drive through the landscapes of the Absheron Peninsula. Upon reaching the hotel in Baku, check-in & rest for a while before going out for the Absheron Peninsula Tour. Witness the Ateshgah Fire Temple, a religious complex dedicated to Zoroastrianism, & Yanar Dag, the Burning Mountain, where natural gas vents ignite continuously, creating a mesmerizing flame. After the tour, transfer back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Absheron Peninsula Tour from Baku on a Private basis

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Check-out from the hotel and get transferred to the airport to board your flight back home. Do not forget to take cherished memories of your unforgettable journey through Azerbaijan.
